item.title: Waterlogging cripples Mirpur after heavy rain
item.content:encoded: Several roads in Mirpur 10 and Kazipara went under knee-deep water on Saturday morning after three hours of rain. Commuters waded through the water. The city corporation said pumps were running. A long article continues here with many more details about drainage, canals and the city's plans, more than three hundred characters, so that only an excerpt can be stored and the rest is never kept by CARCUX at all.
